body.title: Key graph reads on the containing repository at all four plan-context sites
body.summary: Use graphRepoOf(scope) for repoPath and closureRepos at step plan (phases/plan.ts), step narrow resume (phases/narrow.ts), the one-shot shaper session (context/driver.ts) and one-shot executePlan (context/driver.ts), passing the named area as ctx.scope; the resumed plan uses the same key as the paused one.
acceptanceChecks: for a module and a manifest-dir scope with entities stored under the registered repository, module.profile and symbol.locate return the module's entities on both tools
a post-narrow resume uses the same repository key
a repo or workspace scope keeps today's values

oneshot-module-scope.test.ts: the one-shot shaper session and executePlan use graphRepoOf(scope) for module and manifest-dir scopes
